description: adaptive is a Pure Data external library by Georg Holzmann that provides least-mean-square (LMS) and normalized LMS adaptive-filter objects, including lms~, lms2~, nlms~, and nlms2~.

research.notes: The library is verified in Deken and in the historical Pure Data repository under externals/grh/adaptive. No authoritative standalone repository was found; the repository URL is the official Pd-extended GitLab monorepo containing the migrated external collection, and the issue URL is the historical Pure Data project-wide tracker.
